findings.claim: CheckPolicy trusts the working-tree policy.json's mode when policyBase fails, so editing acdsl/policy.json to {"mode":"free","base_ref":"no-such-ref"} makes the gate silently pass with zero diagnostics, defeating the base-ref-authoritative self-management policy engine in strict/gated repos.
findings.fix: Resolve the base using a fixed, non-tamperable candidate chain (origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master) regardless of policy.BaseRef — use BaseRef only as an additional first-try, never the sole candidate — and gate the unresolvable-base-is-an-error decision on whether any base resolves, never on the mode field of the working-tree policy file.

findings.claim: styleTestPrompt deviates from the approved plan text (2026-08-27-smine-profile-settings D9) without the post-approval adjustment being recorded in the plan's Changelog as RULE-PLAN-049 requires.
findings.fix: Backfill a one-line Changelog row in the plan documenting the prompt change and its error_max_turns rationale.

findings.claim: No test exercises the free mode + unresolvable base_ref combination from SP-001; TestCheckPolicyUnresolvableBase only covers gated mode with a bad base_ref.
findings.fix: After fixing SP-001, add an explicit test case for free mode with an unresolvable base_ref so the bypass cannot regress silently.
